how: THE READING OF THE UNMARKED LINES, 2026-11-18. These lines stood under record web-st13-02, verified; no sorter had marked them, so main had not read them one by one. Main read all 990 such lines of the lane against their records' grounds. Narrowed: line 1327: a statement about the reach of its own run.
